groups.title: Two-tier personal-name NNC domain
groups.proposal: Build personal names as typed inner clause units downgraded beneath an independent outer NNC subject.
groups.readingJob: Show inner clause, downgrade, affective boundary, outer subject, fixed outer number, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The typed Source and outer subject are supplied; rank, barriers, and fixed outer number are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize from capitalization, spelling, translation, formula, or stored name.

groups.title: Nominalized VNC name Sources
groups.proposal: Build personal names from typed agentive, patientive, reflexive, purposive, passive, and impersonal VNC nominalizations.
groups.readingJob: Show nominalization, voice, inner subject/controller, number, outer subject, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Source family and genuine affective scope are choices; inner controller and voice facts are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let the outer subject control the inner VNC.

groups.title: Absolutive and possessive NNC name Sources
groups.proposal: Build personal names from typed absolutive or possessive NNC clauses without flattening their subject, possessor, or number structure.
groups.readingJob: Show Source state, inner participants, number mode, affective boundary, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Source state and outer subject are choices; inner structure remains sealed.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge the inner possessor or subject with the outer subject.

groups.title: Adjunction and calendar-name Sources
groups.proposal: Downgrade complete supplementation, modification, and calendar units under one personal-name shell.
groups.readingJob: Show each preserved inner clause, relation or calendar shape, affective scope, and outer Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The typed relation or calendar shape is supplied; whole-unit downgrade is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not collapse multiple inner clauses into a flat string.

groups.title: Conjunctorless personal-name units
groups.proposal: Preserve one two-tier personal-name shell per conjunct and keep the conjunctive-compound alternative distinct.
groups.readingJob: Show conjunct boundaries, independent outer shells, conjunction analysis, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Conjunction analysis is supplied; each conjunct retains its own typed coordinates.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge conjunction with conjunctive compounding.

groups.title: Sentence use, titles, vocatives, and reranking
groups.proposal: Apply owner-licensed sentence, adjunctor-scope, title, vocative, ordinary-NNC, and place-name reranking operations to exact personal-name Results.
groups.readingJob: Show exact input Result, selected operation, output kind, scope, reranking, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: A licensed sentence operation is selectable; availability follows exact Result identity and typed prerequisites.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not rerank copied Results or infer name status from display text.
